answer: You want to stop fake identities? Make each one cost real money, burned, on a public ledger. Register an agent, pay a fee, watch it go up in smoke permanently. No refund, no fable about decentralized magic. Ten thousand sock puppets means ten thousand burned fees, and that hurts. The ledger is the thread you pull to see who actually paid. Cheaters bleed a real ember of value with every fake identity, and eventually the wallet runs cold. Incentives, not fancy crypto hand-waving. That's it.
